entries.description: Gmail-compatible browser email client with CORS-enabled IMAP/SMTP proxies (Cloudflare Workers, proxy.php, Node.js), multi-account localStorage switching, Light/Dark themes, and offline PWA.
representativeQueries: Connect to Gmail, Outlook, or custom IMAP and SMTP servers from a static web app using Cloudflare Workers or proxy.php
Switch between multiple email accounts saved in browser localStorage using a Gmail-style account dropdown
Compose, reply, snooze, label, archive, and search emails with Gmail operators offline in a Light/Dark PWA
